notes: Read-only Stage60 native bank, Stage64 source/proposal cache and train-monitor partition, Stage63 legal development anchors.
Both trained arms receive the SAME source-flow RGB proposal in the native reactive condition; inactive pixels remain the original source.
Native shares source, anchor, mask and seed but uses its original source-reactive condition and frozen pretrained weights.
RAE state contains observed source and full-reference edit difference. It is not the small Stage64 residual on top of the RGB bypass.
The state bridge enters VACE control tokens at every denoising step. Flow loss trains bridge and rank16 LoRA; Stream, RAE and native base weights remain frozen.
RGB control uses source/edit RGB pixel patches with the same bridge width and LoRA. Its input projection has more parameters; report actual counts, do not claim exact parameter equality.
Future edited target frames are training supervision only, never proposal, mask, reference state or inference conditions. Train first-frame paired references are explicitly declared.
Separate reference-prefix slot from video temporal positions; exclude prefix from video flow loss and remove it before VAE decoding.
Same maximum training budget and data/noise schedule for RGB and RAE; independent convergence selection can stop arms at different steps. Record actual update counts.
Final videos, checkpoints, EMA, intermediate previews, DI_throughput units and dual publication are required outputs. No quality threshold suppresses independent arms.
